newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - US Airways upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - US Airways upgraded.

text.p: -- SBC Warburg analyst Timothy Ross said in a research note he raised his recommendation on US Airways Group Inc to add from hold and increased the 1997 fiscal year earnings estimate to $4.27 per share from $3.16.
-- The 1997 first quarter estimate is now $0.51 per share up from $0.07, and the second quarter outlook has been raised to $2.34 per share from $1.77.

-- "The near-term increases have been driven by sustained traffic growth, an absence of negative climatic influences, cost control and development of (the company's) Philadelphia hub," according to the note.
